items.title: My Brief Summer Fling With Siri AI
items.summary: I was initially enamored with the beta version of Apple’s revamped smartphone assistant. As the full release approaches, I’ve forgotten Siri AI even exists.
items.author: Reece Rogers

items.title: Why China Is the Bogeyman Data Center Enthusiasts Just Can't Quit
items.summary: Polls show that overwhelming majorities of Americans hate data centers. China makes a perfect scapegoat for tech leaders and their allies—the only problem is a lack of evidence.
items.author: Molly Taft
